intake: spiritual-unaffiliated - I believe everything is one conscious energy (Source, not a man in the sky); raised Baptist in Mississippi, walked out at 20, and yoga and meditation are my church now.

walk.note: That is exactly how it went for me; you get handed a story before you can ask for one.
No proof outside testimony, fine, and 'God is being itself' is closer to what I actually believe than anything the preacher said.
If God is being itself, then being is the evidence; nothing is hiding, you are standing in it, so the 'not all-powerful or a subject' fork never gets off the ground.
A prayer study on heart patients rules out a vending-machine God, not Source; you tested a cartoon and then threw out the whole thing.
Granting atheism, yes, mind still does not look like it comes from meat alone.
The brain is a radio, not the station; you say chemistry runs the brain and I say chemistry is energy too, so where is the problem?
Fields, energy, information - now you are talking my language.
Reality is experience at bottom; I have believed that since my first long sit.
'The brain is the only structure known to create consciousness' is just your assumption restated; the dreamer is the whole, and you only ruled that out back at 3 and 4, which I did not take.
Others are conscious, yes - I would say more than just the ones with brains, but I will take it.
Ahimsa. Treat them well before you can prove anything. Yes.
Knowing that you do not know is the whole practice; the entropy paragraph lost me but I did not need it.
Hope, yes, held with eyes open; I would have gotten there in two sentences instead of a page and I do not buy the part where beings cannot carry themselves past the bottom.
Hope toward the unseen does not need a maker, much less a finished one; you even admit a maker need not be resolved and then go there anyway.
'More of a bargain than an argument' - a bargain with who, for what? Say what happened.
'To think is to ignore' assumes the big mind has to think the way we do; awareness without thought is the thing you touch in meditation, there is plenty of someone home.
The good is in beings, in everything, I agree with that part wholeheartedly.
You do not need to be remembered to continue; the wave goes back to the ocean and I would pick that over living in somebody else's memory.
You are waiting on a machine to tell you whether the inside is real; I would not wait, I would sit down for twenty minutes and check.

first_exit.why: You defined God as being itself one step earlier and then asked why God does not show up as a separate piece of data. If God is being, being is the evidence - it is not hiding, you are made of it. The either/or at the end only works against the man-in-the-sky God I already left behind.

comment: You throw out the big dreamer at moves 3 and 4 with a prayer study, then spend the rest of the map building something that looks an awful lot like it with a new name - just say 'God is being itself' once and mean it. Half of these moves start with 'if the last premise is true,' and I never took the premise, so the if does all the work. And you do not need data from a machine that does not exist to know the inside is real; that is the one thing every person already has direct access to.
